name: Remove Background
title: How to Remove a Plain Photo Background — Colour & PNG Guide
description: Remove an edge-connected plain background locally, choose white or a custom colour, and download PNG or JPG. Not AI removal for complex scenes.
intro: Prepare a photo taken against a simple, single-colour backdrop without sending it to an image service. Pocket Helper samples a corner colour and removes similar pixels connected to the image boundary. You can correct the colour selection and adjust tolerance before exporting.
steps: Upload or drop a JPG, PNG or WebP photo with a plain backdrop.
Check the preview, pick the original background colour if needed, and adjust tolerance. Choose transparent, a preset colour or a custom colour.
Compare Original and Edited, then download PNG for transparency or JPG with a solid background.
example: A computer shop can prepare a product photo taken against a white wall, remove that plain backdrop and export a transparent PNG for a flyer. Inspect pale edges and fine details before using it.
limits: This is colour-based, edge-connected removal, not AI subject segmentation. Hair or clothing similar to the backdrop can be removed. Complex scenery is not supported. Input is limited to 15 MB and 24 megapixels; editing is reduced to at most 2000 pixels on the longest side.
question: Is this an AI background remover like remove.bg?
answer: No. This tool is designed for plain, single-colour backdrops. It does not identify a person or object with an AI segmentation model. For complex backgrounds, use an appropriate segmentation editor.

name: Face Retouch
title: How to Retouch a Portrait — Light, Softening & Spot Brush Guide
description: Adjust portrait brightness and shadows, detect a face locally, soften a selected area and blend small spots. Preview edits and export PNG or JPG.
intro: Make small portrait adjustments while keeping control of the result. Pocket Helper provides local face detection to position a softening area, brightness and shadow controls, and a manual brush that blends a small blemish toward the surrounding colour. Original view makes comparisons easy.
steps: Upload a portrait. Wait for local face detection, or select the face centre yourself if no face is found.
Adjust light and softening gradually. Enable the spot brush and click a small blemish; Undo removes the most recent spot correction.
Compare Original and Edited, inspect skin and eye detail, and download a PNG or JPG.
example: For a non-official profile photo taken in uneven lighting, slightly raise the shadows and soften a small area. Use a low-strength spot blend and compare the result with the original to retain natural texture.
limits: This is not Photoshop, skin reconstruction or an identity-photo validator. The brush blends neighbouring colour rather than restoring missing detail. Detection may miss faces; with multiple faces, the largest is selected. Input limit: 15 MB and 24 megapixels. Editing is capped at 2000 pixels; the smaller interactive preview does not set export dimensions. Do not use retouching where passport or ID rules prohibit it.
question: Are portrait photos uploaded for face detection?
answer: No. Detection runs in the browser using model files served by Pocket Helper. The photo is not sent to a face-detection API. The first use needs time to load the model, and speed depends on the device.

name: Passport Photo & Print
title: How to Make a Passport Photo Print Sheet — Sizes & PDF Guide
description: Crop photos to 35×45 mm, 2×2 inch or custom sizes. Resize JPGs, set a target KB limit and create A4 or 4×6 photo-sheet PDFs in your browser.
intro: Prepare a photo for a printing workflow with explicit dimensions rather than guessing its size on a page. Choose a common preset or custom pixels, position the crop and generate a PDF sheet with copies arranged at their intended physical size. Always follow the receiving institution's instructions.
steps: Upload a photo, choose a size preset and adjust zoom, position or rotation to frame the subject.
Check the background and photo requirements. For an official application, avoid retouching or background edits unless expressly allowed.
Download a single JPG or PNG, or choose a sheet size and copy count for a PDF. Print the PDF at Actual size / 100%.
example: Arrange six 35×45 mm photos on a 4×6 inch sheet. The layout reserves margins and gaps; if the requested number does not fit, the tool asks you to reduce the count instead of silently shrinking the photos.
limits: Passport and visa requirements vary by country and application. This tool does not verify head size, expression or official acceptance. Input limit: 15 MB and 24 megapixels; editing source is capped at 2000 pixels. Custom output is 50–2400 pixels per side and print dimensions use 300 DPI. A target JPG file size may require smaller dimensions; it is not guaranteed at every resolution.
question: Does a 35×45 mm preset guarantee passport acceptance?
answer: No. A dimension preset only sets the output shape and print size. Check the official rules for background, head position, recency, expression and permitted editing before submitting.

name: Assignment Cover Maker
title: How to Make an Assignment Cover — A4 Layout & Export Guide
description: Make a white A4 assignment cover with student name, roll, course, teacher and optional university logo. Six designs, Bengali or English labels, PDF and PNG.
intro: Create a clean cover page for a university or college assignment without laying out every line manually. Pocket Helper offers six white-paper designs, restrained accent colours and separate submitted-by and submitted-to sections. Type Bengali or English details and review the live preview before downloading.
steps: Choose Classic, Modern, Editorial, Minimal, Arch or Scholar, pick an accent colour and select Bengali or English cover labels. Optionally upload your institution logo.
Enter the institution, assignment topic, course and code, student name and roll, teacher details and submission date. Leave optional fields blank when unnecessary.
Review spelling and layout, then download A4 PDF or PNG. Use Actual size / 100% when printing and follow your institution's required format.
example: A Management student can add their name, roll, session, course title, assignment topic and lecturer details, then export a restrained navy cover on white A4 paper. Load sample demonstrates the layout; replace all sample details before submission.
limits: This creates a cover, not the assignment content. PDF output contains a high-resolution image and is not editable text. Name, institution and topic are required for export. Long text must fit the layout; shorten it if warned. Optional logo input is limited to 3 MB and 12 megapixels. Details are not saved automatically, so reloading clears the form.
question: Can I use Bengali text on the cover?
answer: Yes. The cover uses locally hosted Bengali fonts and supports Bengali or English labels. Wait for fonts to load before exporting. The design is not an official university template; use the prescribed format if your department requires one.
